# QMD Graph Quality Score

## Purpose
Borrowing from the old vault, EMA should measure graph quality rather than hand-wave it.

## Candidate metrics
- frontmatter completeness
- outgoing related links present
- inbound hub links present
- summary present
- provenance present
- freshness present
- object/track metadata present
- orphan page count

## Why
A connected graph should be inspectable and improvable over time.
